t: Cured Meat: The Pre-Agricultural Engine of Göbekli Tepe and the Forced Birth of Agriculture
s: This hypothesis proposes cured meat, enabled by mass hunting tech like desert kites/buffalo jumps, fueled pre-agricultural settlements like Göbekli Tepe, before resource depletion forced a pivot to agriculture.
sub: Desert kites/buffalo jumps as mass hunting surplus engines
Cured meat (Pemmican) as a pre-agricultural superfood and economic driver
Göbekli Tepe as a pre-agricultural settlement funded by meat surplus
Unsustainable surplus leading to resource depletion and societal stress
Forced pivot to agriculture via livestock consuming 'poo gardens'
